source_contracts.role: PlateLining versus UnderPlate versus body/cloth obstacles
source_contracts.trace: PlateLining privately owns the wearer-facing rigid surface and matching per-triangle rim masks; it filters GeneratedArmor per-triangle PlateFace::Inner, the canonical semantic enum whose other distinct roles are Outer/Edge. GeneratedArmor123-143 explicitly stores one face per triangle or empty for an unthickened piece. UnderPlate adds one garment-specific standoff to an Arc shared lining. This is distinct from arbitrary body/cloth obstacles and from the source full rigid piece; flattening these owners would lose the wearer-facing and garment-offset contracts.

source_contracts.role: Actual under-plate producer and semantic equipment ordering
source_contracts.trace: Outfit drape_inputs walks actual loadout.draped in reverse, creates each input from the same model/generated body, and only supplies UnderPlate when lining exists and channel.order is below RigidArmor.order. Canonical EquipmentChannel147-172 owns order Held0,BaseClothing10,Padding20,FlexibleArmor30,RigidArmor40,Outerwear50,... . covers is that general named predicate, not an independently stored Boolean or new channel taxonomy. Actual garment collection narrows callers; do not silently redefine covers as a closed list. Producer starts over=LINING_CLEARANCE_M0.001, standoff=over+fabric.particle_radius, accumulates twice that radius and reverses back to inner-first. These are metre clearance, half-thickness and accumulated layer depth roles, not arbitrary interchangeable f32 parameters.

source_contracts.role: Per-triangle rim edge predicates and original triangle ordinal
source_contracts.trace: Merged positions apply one per-piece vertex offset; inner triangles and their rim masks derive from the same ordered triangle list. Edge use is counted on unordered endpoint position-bit keys so duplicated vertices at equal bit coordinates share the lining edge. Three Boolean flags are local edge-membership predicates in triangle-corner order; replacing each with a new role enum is unsupported. BVH TriangleBvh395-402 constructs bounds in triangle order; Bvh48-68 explicitly defines bounds order as reported primitive numbering, closest302-325 returns the winning original primitive, and walk359-383 calls leaf on self.indices entries. triangle413-419 indexes that same list. press therefore consumes same-index rim mask/triangle, not a traversal-node ordinal. Native query tuple roles are locally named on destructuring; no duplicate BVH identity owner proposed.

source_contracts.role: Raw exact-coordinate edge keys versus mesh indices
source_contracts.trace: HashMap key ([u32;3],[u32;3]) holds endpoint f32 bit patterns, not triangle/vertex identifiers despite u32 storage. min/max only canonicalizes unordered endpoints; counter counts uses. This actual numerical topology key is homogeneous endpoint data. No evidence justifies epsilon welding, normalizing signed zero, geometric ordering or extra validation policy here; those would change the present matching policy.

source_contracts.role: Press optional displacement and numerical spreading
source_contracts.trace: press returns None for no nearby lining, rim hit or insufficient positive depth; Some is the displacement vector toward wearer based on winding and standoff. tuck_under forms one Option<Vec3> per sewn vertex, preserving distinction between directly covered vertices and uncovered vertices whose numeric spread starts zero. Covered vertices retain direct displacement; uncovered neighbours receive named SPREAD fraction over bounded rounds; presses and sewn coordinates share enumeration. Self.sewn/neighbours/expand belong to the already-traced SewnCloth producer/receiver in781; returning expanded positions feeds same conformation path. distance_to_segment is bounded local vector arithmetic with dimensionless clamped projection, not a new physical role owner.

source_contracts.role: Named metre lengths, fractions and algorithm counts
source_contracts.trace: REACH_M limits nearest lining search, RIM_TOLERANCE_M excludes boundary hits, UnderPlate.standoff sets garment mid-surface depth, SPREAD is a dimensionless smoothing share, and PRESS_ROUNDS/SPREAD_ROUNDS count separate algorithm stages. Their matching primitive storage does not justify merging roles. Native dot/cross/projection arrays have actual numerical uses, but raw metre standoff remains a canonical physical-owner propagation question before this port; no bounds or new independent wrapper invented.

source_contracts.role: Existing tests and native fixture construction
source_contracts.trace: Full existing fixtures read only. GeneratedArmor uses canonical PlateFace and PackedRigSkin with native test geometry; test calls cover through-plate, rim/out-of-reach and channel cases. No execution, additions, restoration, validation credit or whole generator admission proof.
